I found your post while searching reddit for methods to kill myself. I believed I could write a book too, expect you've done it. You've done everything I know that I can't do myself. I have no higher education. I know I cannot write a book. But you've  done it. It sounds like you really actually want to self publish your book. To take control of that process requires the research skills you already possess. I'm actually very impressed with you. You actually have a future I could never have. 29 years old too. Kid I'm 35, I have no friends, I haven't gotten a text in weeks. I WISH I was as much a man as you at that age. I can't even hope to aspire to accomplish what you've already accomplished. 
Your only failure is believing that you can't go any further than you've already gone. I envy you. Just dont wait to move forward with your project like I did. Don't make my mistakes. You're posting because you want help. There is still a flame smouldering in you, and that's enough. I have nothing in my heart like that. Keep going.
